sources.title: Caitlyn Build Guide: 26.19 Master ADC Caitlyn Guide — 1 Shot Late Game Scaling Caitlyn Build

passive.name: Headshot
passive.text: Every few basic attacks, or against a target she has trapped or netted, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing bonus damage that scales with her critical strike chance. On trapped or netted targets, Caitlyn's Headshot attack range is doubled.

spells.name: Piltover Peacemaker
spells.text: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets).

spells.name: Yordle Snap Trap
spells.text: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.

spells.name: 90 Caliber Net
spells.text: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.

spells.name: Ace in the Hole
spells.text: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.

damage.value: Caitlyn deals physical burst damage with Piltover Peacemaker and bonus-damage Headshots.

archetype.value: Caitlyn is a long-range ADC who uses her range and traps to control fights.

axis.value: Caitlyn can play a poke lane that builds an early gold lead.

winCondition.value: Caitlyn wins fights by positioning well, using her range, and placing traps to control the battlefield.

spikes.why: Caitlyn's build is designed to scale into one-shot damage.

spikes.at: When Piltover Peacemaker reaches its lowest cooldown
spikes.why: Caitlyn can use it every 6 seconds instead of every 10 seconds.

mistakes.value: Caitlyn players can give up too much damage by leaving fights before using their range and abilities fully.
Caitlyn can lose an intended Ace in the Hole hit when another enemy champion intercepts its bullet.
